headline: Profit jumps on higher interest income and fees
summary_short: SMFG reported Q1 FY2027 (three months ended June 30, 2026) ordinary profit of ¥693.1 billion, up 43.4% y/y, with net income attributable to owners of parent of ¥501.4 billion (+33.0% y/y) and basic EPS of ¥131.62 (+35.1% y/y).
summary_long: Ordinary income rose 16.6% year-over-year to ¥2,850.4 billion, and ordinary profit jumped 43.4% to ¥693.1 billion. Net income attributable to owners of parent grew 33.0% to ¥501.4 billion, with basic EPS of ¥131.62 (+35.1% y/y). Total net assets rose to ¥16.24 trillion from ¥15.93 trillion at fiscal year-end, while total assets were roughly flat. SMFG reaffirmed its FY2027 (ending March 2027) earnings forecast of ¥1,700.0 billion profit attributable to owners of parent (+7.4% y/y) and forecast EPS of ¥223.58, both explicitly unchanged, along with an unchanged FY2027 annual dividend forecast of ¥180.00/share before the pending 2-for-1 stock split (record date September 30, 2026).
confidence_notes: SMFG's fiscal year runs April-March; the filing labels this period the three months ended June 30, 2026 (SMFG's own fiscal Q1 FY2027), while the platform's period label follows our 'FY2026 Q2' convention -- a labeling-convention difference, not a data mismatch. KPI figures above are read directly from the filed Japanese-GAAP consolidated results rather than the resolver's kpis object: the resolver's eps_usd actual (0.49527 USD) and prior_yy (58.476, left in JPY) mix currencies and don't reconcile -- a data-quality issue in the wire feed, not in the filing. All figures here are as-filed, same-currency (million yen); the y/y percentages for ordinary income/profit/net income match the release's own disclosed change percentages exactly.

drivers.explanation: Per the company's own segment profit-driver table, growth was led by higher net interest income (+¥165.6bn y/y) and net fees and commissions (+¥75.1bn y/y), partly offset by higher G&A expenses (+¥112.5bn y/y).
